name: Computational geometry
summary: Shamos names the field and gives algorithms for geometric problems.

name: Feigenbaum universality
summary: Renormalisation explains universal constants in the period-doubling route.

name: Hilbert's tenth problem over rings of integers: elliptic curves and additive combinatorics
to: undecidability over number-field rings of integers
summary: The remaining cases of undecidability for Diophantine equations over rings of integers were settled using a specially built elliptic curve with quadratic twists and prime selection from additive combinatorics.

name: Hyperbolic geometry enters three-manifold topology (Thurston)
summary: Three-manifolds are decomposed into pieces carrying one of eight model geometries, hyperbolic being generic, so topology is studied with geometric tools.

name: Computers enter proof: four colour theorem and the Kepler conjecture
summary: Exhaustive case analysis by computer is accepted as proof in graph theory, and later whole proofs are re-verified in proof assistants.

name: Number theory becomes applied: public-key cryptography
summary: Modular exponentiation, discrete logarithms, factoring and later elliptic curves are used to build secure protocols, turning classical number theory into infrastructure.

name: Nonlinear PDE proves the Calabi conjecture
summary: The complex Monge-Ampere equation is solved with a priori estimates, producing Ricci-flat Kahler metrics and showing a topological condition forces a metric.

name: Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg: geometric measure theory gives partial regularity for Navier-Stokes
from: geometric measure theory (Hausdorff measure, partial regularity from minimal surfaces)
summary: Hausdorff-measure covering arguments show that suitable weak solutions of the 3D Navier-Stokes equations have a singular set of one-dimensional parabolic measure zero.

name: Pattern theory and variational image models (Mumford)
summary: Statistical and variational models of images and signals are developed as a mathematical theory of perception and vision.

name: Ellipsoid method in combinatorial optimisation
summary: Khachiyan's ellipsoid algorithm is used to prove polynomial solvability of combinatorial problems via separation oracles.
